card.title: Credit for the Impossible
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell your tour group I predicted this floating staircase before anyone else.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm trying to get them upstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mention it before they use the handrail. I predicted that first too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. One sentence, while they're climbing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say, 'Nobody believed these stairs could float until you showed us your drawing.' I'll take questions on the landing.

card.title: Credit for the Impossible
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believed this cupboard could speak when you wanted it scrapped. Say I was first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whisper it. Then we can both respect its wishes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says whispering counts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write it, then. 'You believed before any of us.' I'll put it beside its first words.

card.title: Keep Hope Operational
card.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your daughter's voice crossed from tomorrow. Set her place beside yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She promised we'd share my birthday. Was it really her?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She sang your name. I'll warm two plates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What did the warning about bringing people through say? Should I put hers back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave it. I'll sit beside the receiver until she arrives. You choose the cake; tomorrow shouldn't get the last slice.

card.title: Keep Hope Operational
card.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cloud lifted a raindrop back into the sky. Let's prepare the full demonstration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If I reverse a whole shower, Dad says he'll fund the workshop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've filmed the first drop. I'll mark out the paving for the shower.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Shall I send him the capacity report too? You read it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just the film for now. I'll borrow floodlights; he should see every drop going home.
